notes.title: 🌟 PATCH NOTES - VER. 1.0.0.6.0 🌟
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Below you will find the patch notes for [b]Ver. 1.0.0.6.0[/b]!


[h2]⚔️ CAMPAIGN CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]CHARACTERS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Johnathan Trim[/b] has received a visual update to distinguish him from other characters.
[/list]
[h3]QUESTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Jet Valentine’s[/b] indicator has been repositioned to the correct location.
[*] Completing the encounter with [b]Jet Valentine[/b] now correctly progresses [b]Real Card Blues.[/b]
[*] [b]Janice’s[/b] fail state now resolves correctly.
[*] A new icon has been added for the [b]Dash Hound Derby[/b].
[*] [b]Taco Tim[/b] no longer gives infinite fruit tacos (sorry).
[*] Completing [b]Lemonade Is Life[/b] now removes lingering lemonade cups.
[*] [b]Putting on a Play[/b] can now be completed as intended.
[/list]


[h2]⚔️ GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buildings under construction no longer apply penalties while being built.
[*] The [b]Bouncy Castle[/b] now correctly applies its discount effect.
[*] The [b]Taco Truck[/b] now becomes permanent after a level-up, as intended.
The [b]Ice Cream Truck[/b] now freezes a building at the start of your turn, giving players more time to strategize with its effect.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players now always win the first coin flip against [b]Hawthorne[/b] in the tutorial. This change is intended to support early-game consistency.
[*] The [b]D21 collectible[/b] can now be picked up, as intended.
[/list]


& many more minor bug fixes and QoL improvements.


[hr][/hr]

[h2]📅 VERSION 1.0.0.7.0 COMING 23RD MAY[/h2]
Your feedback continues to shape the future of [b]Wild Country[/b]. Keep the ideas coming on the [b]Steam Community Page[/b] or [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/DJxHVqNAys]our Discord server[/url][/b]—we’re always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).


[hr][/hr]

[h2]👋 UNTIL NEXT TIME![/h2]
Keep exploring, keep discovering, and most importantly—have fun.

Thanks for reading, and see you soon!

[b]Beck Snow ✌️[/b]
[i]Design Director on Wild Country 🦝🏡
[/i]

notes.title: Wild Country – Now Available in Simplified and Traditional Chinese! 🎴
notes.content:
We're excited to share that [b]Wild Country[/b] is now fully localized in both [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] and [b]Traditional Chinese[/b]! This is a big milestone for us—and one we've been quietly working toward for some time.

Players around the world can now experience the full adventure of Big Sky in their language of choice—whether you're crafting your perfect deck, exploring the bustling world of Big Sky, or challenging rivals online.

Here’s what awaits you:
[list]
[*] 🌿 A large pool of cards to collect, learn, and master.
[*] 🌿 A cast of quirky characters and a world full of charm and surprises.
[*] 🌿 Easy-to-learn gameplay with rich, strategic depth for all skill levels.
[*] 🌿 Online multiplayer for friendly duels and fierce competition.
[/list]

To celebrate, [b]Wild Country[/b] is [b]20% off until May 11, 2025[/b] — [u]don’t miss it![/u]

Bringing [b]Wild Country[/b] to more players has always been part of the vision. Thanks to your support, that vision keeps growing. We’re so grateful you're here—and we can’t wait to welcome even more players to the wild, wonderful world of Big Sky.


[hr][/hr]

[h2]👋 UNTIL NEXT TIME![/h2]


Keep exploring, keep discovering, and most importantly—have fun.

Thanks for reading, and see you soon!


[b]Beck Snow ✌️[/b]
[i]Design Director on Wild Country 🦝🏡
[/i]

notes.title: 🌟 PATCH NOTES - VER. 1.0.0.5.0 🌟
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Below you will find the patch notes for [b]Ver. 1.0.0.5.0[/b]!



[h2]✨NEW FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]We’ve given the controls a full overhaul[/b]! While there’s still a bit of polish to come, gameplay now feels much smoother on both keyboard and controller. Give it a go and let us know what you think!
[*] [b]Added a pause state to the Campaign[/b] to make it clear that the game is paused whilst the top bar is open.

[/list]

[h2]🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the "[b]Show Stats[/b]" feature: it’s now more responsive and displays the building type as well as profit per turn.
[*] [b]Map Shortcut [/b]added! Press [b]M[/b] (keyboard) or [b]Y[/b] (controller) to open the map. We've also added the M icon to the UI for clarity.
[*] Added a "[b]Show Stats[/b]" button to the match UI to help you remember it's there.
[*] Removed the [b]Main Menu shortcut[/b] from the settings menu—it's still accessible via the top bar.
[*] Updated the [b]Input tab in the Settings Menu[/b] to reflect the new control scheme.
[*] Replaced the [b]intro trailer[/b] with a new, updated one.
[*] Pressing [b]Esc [/b]now closes all open menus and popups—clean and quick.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]double-tapping Tab[/b] (or pressing right twice on the D-pad) would incorrectly open the Mayor’s Office.

[/list]

& many more minor bug fixes and QoL improvements.


[hr][/hr]

[h2]📅 VERSION 1.0.0.6.0 COMING 2ND MAY[/h2]
Your feedback continues to shape the future of [b]Wild Country[/b]. Keep the ideas coming on the [b]Steam Community Page[/b] or [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/DJxHVqNAys]our Discord server[/url][/b]—we’re always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).


[hr][/hr]

[h2]👋 UNTIL NEXT TIME![/h2]
Keep exploring, keep discovering, and most importantly—have fun.

Thanks for reading, and see you soon!

[b]Beck Snow ✌️[/b]
[i]Design Director on Wild Country 🦝🏡
[/i]

notes.title: 🌟 PATCH NOTES - VER. 1.0.0.3.0 🌟
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Slightly smaller update this week as a lot of the upcoming changes and additions are larger than what can be completed in a two-week period. We’ve got some big things cooking—expect exciting changes and surprises in the coming weeks!

[h2]👋 UNTIL NEXT TIME![/h2]
Keep exploring, keep discovering, and most importantly—have fun.

Thanks for reading, and see you soon!

[b]Beck Snow ✌️[/b]
[i]Design Director on Wild Country 🦝🏡
[/i]

Hey, everyone!

Below you will find the patch notes for [b]Ver. 1.0.0.2.0[/b]!

[h2]⚔️ CAMPAIGN CHANGES[/h2]

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 6 & 7 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Adventurers, we’ve made it to the last of our daily updates for launch week! 

From here on, [b]updates will roll out weekly every Friday[/b], giving us more time to fine-tune, polish, and deliver exciting new improvements. 🚀

This update clears out the clutter and smooths the edges: Amos has finally settled into the right spot 🗺️, Sandy’s stopped her endless chatter (phew! 😅), and those vanishing ties and badges? Back where they belong! 🧑‍🎩✨ We’ve also welcomed more tutorial NPCs to help new players hit the ground running and brought back the match timer ⏱️ to keep your online battles fast and focused.

But wait, there’s more! 🌟 [b]We’re working on a roadmap to share what we’re cooking up next [/b]🍳 and what you can get excited about in the weeks to come. Stay tuned—we’re just getting started, and it’s going to be a wild ride! 🎢

Full patch notes below:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🏡 MATCH CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]⌛[b] Timers are back! [/b]Online matches now have a timer to ensure games stay quick and competitive.
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ CAMPAIGN CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Battles[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]You can no longer face Amos before learning the basics from Hawthorne[/b]. He’ll now wait his turn.
[*][b]Amos[/b] was mistakenly hanging out at The Entrance. He’s been moved to his proper place in Spring Valley.
[/list]
[h3]Conversations[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]CeCe and NaNa have joined The Entrance[/b], chatting (or squawking?) about their favorite new movie. 🍿
[*][b]Six new tutorial NPCs have been added to The Entrance[/b] to explain game mechanics and tips for new players. [b]Three more tutorial NPCs have been added to Spring Valley[/b].
[*][b]Sandy[/b] was accidentally repeating herself during conversations. This has been fixed, so she’ll keep things fresh now.
[/list]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Fantastaco[/b] has been rebuilt from the ground up and is now a fully functional quest—time to get delivering! 🌮
[*]It’s easier to understand who’s working for [b]Bob the Job at the Lumbermill[/b] versus who’s just hanging out. We’ve updated the setting with clearer environmental storytelling.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Competitors and quest givers in The Entrance and Spring Valley are now correctly tracked on your map. 🗺️[/b]
[*]Cosmetic items (like ties, makeup, scars, and badges) are no longer disappearing or acting strangely—they’re fixed and ready to show off! 💄✨
[*]Online Play & Campaign highlights weren’t displaying properly in the second and third mayor’s offices. This has been corrected.
[*]A new tutorial popup explains the mulligan phase during your second match (vs. Robbie), so you’ll know exactly how it works. 🔄
[*]Ranger Tom suggested you change your deck, but it wasn’t clear how to do it. We’ve added a helpful popup to guide you after his advice. 🃏
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! 

Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/DJxHVqNAys]our Discord server[/url]—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

Thanks for an incredible launch week, and here’s to the exciting adventures ahead! 🎊

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 5 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Welcome back, adventurers, to Day 5 of post-launch updates!

We’re in the home stretch of our first week, with just two more days of daily patches to go before the initial release week wraps up. It’s been amazing to see your creativity and strategy in action—every build, every battle, and every bit of feedback helps us make the game even better.

Thanks for being part of this journey with us! Now, let’s dive into what’s new in today’s update: 🎉


[hr][/hr]
[h2]🏡 MATCH CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]🏠 [b]Inspecting a building at the start of your turn no longer freezes your hand[/b]. The game will now let you inspect in peace!
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ CAMPAIGN CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Battles[/h3]
[list]
[*]🛡️ Winning the [b]MJ [/b]and [b]Nate[/b] quest will now properly end the battle without endless repeats or false loss messages. 
[*]🐦 [b]Benjamin Bird[/b] has finished chatting about his latest obsession -  online play - and is ready to face you in a proper duel. Prepare to bring your A-game! 🎮
[*]🏆 Repeated battles with [b]Nate[/b], [b]Jellybean[/b], and [b]Kensington [/b]are no longer possible. One duel is all you need—save the farming for Timberton.🌲
[/list]
[h3]Conversations[/h3]
[list]
[*]🕵️ [b]Skip is no longer pretending to be Benjamin Bird[/b]. Everyone’s identities are back in order!
[/list]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*]🍋 [b]Bertie [/b]will now properly recognize when you’ve collected the cups for the '[b]Lemonade is Life[/b]' quest, so you can finally complete it. 🥤
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]🪝 Two messages in bottles (Galactic Report Log #327-A & DESTROY AFTER READING) now have their descriptions restored!
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS[/h2]
[list]
[*]🐻 [b]Billy Bearclaw[/b] now has a collider and properly interacts with the world around him.
[*]Graham’s transformation into a beaver is complete—his character model now reflects his true self. 🦫
[*]🧍‍♀️ [b]Lucy Claws[/b] and [b]MJ [/b]no longer overlap with other characters. Everyone’s got their space back.
[*]🎚️ [b]The key items scrollbar is fully functional again[/b], making it easier to navigate your inventory.
[*]🆙 There was a bit of confusion with level progress not syncing correctly between the Player Profile and the Mayor’s Office. Now [b]the level-up bar updates perfectly across all screens![/b]🌟
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! 

Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/DJxHVqNAys]our Discord server[/url]—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 4 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Welcome back, adventurers, to Day 4 of post-launch updates!

Happy Thanksgiving to all who celebrate! 🦃

It’s been awesome seeing the creative builds and clever strategies you’ve come up with so far—you’re already surprising us in the best ways. Your feedback and enthusiasm keep us motivated as we keep making the game better and better.

Let’s check out what’s new in this update!: 🎉


[hr][/hr]
[h2]🎮 SYSTEM CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Cards & Card Packs[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Rebel Riot [/b]
- Rebel Riot was only targeting Commercial buildings. Now? No one is safe from the chaos! 🌆🔥
[/list]

[h2]🏡 MATCH CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Statuses[/h3]
[list]
[*]Buildings were sometimes showing two level-up icons by mistake—double trouble! That’s been fixed, so things are back to leveling up smoothly. 📈✨
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ CAMPAIGN CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Battles[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Pico[/b] was giving everyone the silent treatment, making battles impossible. He’s ready to fight again—good luck! 💥
[*][b]Kiara[/b] couldn’t let go and kept challenging players after losing. She’s now taking time to recover. 😅
[*][b]Amos[/b] was speaking pure gibberish after defeat, blocking his quest. He’s now back to making sense. 🗨️
[*][b]Jellybean[/b] thought she won even when she lost—and even handed out rewards for losing! That mix-up is now sorted. 🍭
[/list]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Squirrel Me Timbers[/b] has had a complete revamp! [b]Visit Captain Cloverfield in Mystery Falls[/b] to kick off this exciting adventure. 🐻✨
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Oops! There was a sneaky entry to Beartooth Point from Mystery Falls that let players in early. We’ve blocked it off with rocks—no shortcuts now! 🪨⛔
[*]Skip was impersonating Benjamin. Identity theft is no joke, and [b]Skip now has his proper name.[/b] 🙃
[*]Player level in the Mayor’s Office wasn’t lining up with the Match Results Screen. We’ve fixed it so everything matches perfectly now! ✔️
[*][b]You can now see your exact XP progress toward the next level[/b], displayed on both the Match Results Screen and your player profile—making it easier than ever to track your growth! 🌟
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! 

Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/DJxHVqNAys]our Discord server[/url]—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 3 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Welcome back, adventurers, to Day 3 of post-launch updates!

A huge shoutout to everyone sharing bug reports on Discord—you’re helping us iron out the kinks and make Wild Country shine. And to those leaving reviews on our page, thank you! Your support and feedback mean the world and help us grow even stronger. ✨

Curious about what’s improved today? Let’s dive into the details below! 🎉

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🎮 SYSTEM CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Cards & Card Packs[/h3]
[list]
[*]The [b]Apple Card[/b] was incorrectly giving $20 instead of the $50 shown on the card. This bug has been squashed, and the card is now as juicy as it claims! 🍎💵
[/list]
[h3]Collection[/h3]
[list]
[*]When you added and removed a card from a deck, your card count sneakily went up by one each time. Not anymore—back to honest collecting!
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Battles[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Nate Laboto[/b] and [b]Amos[/b] were unavailable for battles due to a bug. They’re now back and ready to play! 💥
[/list]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Pico[/b], [b]Gorp[/b], and [b]Nicky[/b] wouldn’t talk to players after being defeated, blocking their quests. They’re now all ears, and their quests can be completed! 🗨️
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]The [b]Bearclaw Mayoral Poster[/b] & [b]Competition Announcement[/b] now have the correct info. 📝
[/list]
[h3]Minigames[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Litter League[/b] had a bug that made things messy. We’ve temporarily disabled it while we tidy it up. 🗑️✨
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Online play now correctly unlocks at level 3. 🌐
[*]The scroll bar in the "Key Items" section of the Collection book is now working as intended. 📜
[*][b]MJ[/b] and [b]Captain Bayler[/b] were overlapping in the game world. They’ve agreed to give each other some space. 🧍‍♂️↔️🧍‍♂️
[*][b]Pepper[/b] was incorrectly giving out rewards before being battled. This has been fixed—no more freebies! 🎁
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! 

Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/DJxHVqNAys]our Discord server[/url]—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 2 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Welcome back, adventurers, to Day 2 of post-launch updates!

Thanks to your sharp eyes and helpful feedback, we’ve been squashing bugs, polishing features, and making everything a little more fun for your journey ahead. Every step forward is a step toward making the Wild Country the best it can be!

Ready to see what’s been improved today? Let’s dive into the details below!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🎮 SYSTEM CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now open the map by pressing the [b]'M'[/b] button.
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Battles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed two issues with buildings featuring a construction timer: 
- Countdown timers now count down correctly
- Timers disappear as intended once they hit zero, allowing construction to complete smoothly.
[/list]

[h3]Conversations[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Nicky[/b] & [b]Kevin[/b] have stopped repeating themselves. We all love a good story, but once is enough!
[*][b]Kensington[/b], [b]Matilda[/b], & [b]Nicky[/b] now let you battle them as intended.
[*][b]Snickerdoodle[/b] is ready to chat and challenge you to a race—better start stretching!
[*][b]Pico[/b] & [b]Gorp[/b] no longer begin their conversations with error text (they promise to use real words now).
[*]The following characters now have functional dialogue and are ready to chat:
[b]Meatball, Ranger Tom, Gorton Hinge, Red Herring, Jet Valentine, Stefan, Jellybean, The Captains, The Pirates, MJ, Nate Laboto, Natalie, Benjamin Bird, Pepper, Sandy, Tony Galore, Bob the Job, Donnie, Kevin[/b], and [b]Flippers[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*]Defeating [b]Poppy[/b] will now complete her quest as intended.
[*][b]'Camping Sucks'[/b], [b]'Sad Pancakes'[/b], and [b]'Lemonade is Life'[/b] can now be completed. 
[*][b]Round 4 of 'Journey to Sun City' has been fixed[/b]. Speak to [b]Ranger Tom[/b] to progress to Round 5.
[/list]

[h3]Minigames[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]'Dash Hound Derby'[/b] has now been fixed! You can now [b]Race Snickerdoodle in Spring Valley[/b].
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with bear models where their eyes bulged unexpectedly.
[*]Adjusted scrolling boundaries during matches to reduce sensitivity—You can now interact with the UI without the camera scrolling!
[*]Improved text readability for the [b]'Confirm'[/b] text during the mulligan phase.
Collectible popups now scale correctly with text length, ensuring no more overflow or messy displays.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! 

Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/DJxHVqNAys]our Discord server[/url]—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 1 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Welcome, adventurers, to your first official update post-launch! 

We've been hard at work ironing out quirks, fixing typos, and making the Wild Country even wilder. This is just the beginning—we'll be rolling out daily patches to keep improving the game and ensuring your journey gets better and better every step of the way.

Ready to see what's new? Dive in below!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]✨ NEW FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*]The "[b]Unstuck Me![/b]" button in the Extras tab (Settings Menu) teleports you back to The Entrance if you get stuck. No more awkward cliff-hanging moments—literally!
[*]Say goodbye to guessing games! We [b]added card information popups to the mulligan phase[/b] to help you make informed decisions on the cards you may not be as familiar with! These were previously bound to the Collection and during matches.
[/list]

[h2]🎮 SYSTEM CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]CARDS & CARD PACKS[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented [b]rare card packs[/b] from being opened. They should now function as intended, so you can enjoy your well-earned rewards without a hitch!
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Conversations & Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Jellybean[/b], [b]Kevin[/b], and [b]Birdie[/b] weren't feeling too chatty. We've fixed their dialogue, and now they're ready to spill the tea.
[*][b]Mystic Mike[/b] was caught repeating himself—classic Mystic Mike! We gave him a nudge, and he's now more mysterious than ever!
[/list][h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]The missing description was added to the "[b]I Got In[/b]" Collectible.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Minor typos in [b]Jet Valentine's dialogue[/b] and the [b]intro paragraph[/b] have been resolved. 
[b]Paco[/b] and [b]Natalie[/b] shared the same location. Natalie has now relocated to Camp Oaknut for some well-deserved breathing room.
[*][b]Spooky Steve[/b] was showing some concerning behavior. He's left the Canyon for now, but don't worry—he'll haunt us again soon. 👻
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/DJxHVqNAys]our Discord server[/url]—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

notes.title: Play the Wild Country Demo during the Summer Games Fest
notes.content:
Don't miss the return of the Wild Country demo, available for a limited time during the [b]Summer Game Fest's Women-Led Games event[/b] between the [b]8th - 15th of June[/b]!

If you've played Wild Country before, you'll notice we've introduced quality-of-life fixes, mechanical tweaks, and balance changes based on community feedback and beta testing. [b]We'd love to hear your thoughts on these changes![/b]

[h3]What's in the demo?[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🏡 CCG x City Building Gameplay.
[*] 🦝 Deck & Character Customisation
[*] 🌲 A Snippet of the Single-Player Campaign
[*] 🏆 Quests, collectibles, minigames + more!
[/list]
[h3]Where can I post my feedback?[/h3]
Please share your demo feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/UXR9evaR8Y]Discord[/url]!

Enjoyed the demo? Want more Wild Country? Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/PlayWildCountry]Twitter[/url] and join [url=https://discord.gg/UXR9evaR8Y]our official Discord[/url]! Get sneak peeks of new card designs and see what we're working on next. 

Hit that wishlist button on Steam to stay updated and be the first to know when the game launches.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515000/Wild_Country/


[hr][/hr]
Wild Country will launch on [b]PC, Xbox, & Nintendo Switch[/b] in [b]2024[/b] 🏕️🦝.

[hr][/hr]
New to Wild Country? Join [url=https://discord.gg/UXR9evaR8Y]our official Discord server[/url]!

Connect with a welcoming and enthusiastic community eager to chat about all things Wild Country. Get tips, make friends, and dive deeper into the adventure together!
